visualCharacteristics: "Powered by / Presented by" emblem band, followed by the feedback card pair and the page attribution (last updated, maintained by); "Send feedback" opens an inline form.
contentPattern: Rows: emblem logos and labels, feedback heading and copy, survey/contact text and links, last-updated date, maintainer.
usage: Bottom of listing and landing pages (news, services, neighborhoods, community engagement).
reuseGuidance: Reuse where the emblem band closes a page; use (plain) to show the emblem band without the feedback pair. Use feedback for the feedback pair alone.
